comment: Sample task injected by product_e2e_smoke after `argo onboard` completes. The product e2e test reads this, fills in the action_id + worker_id + vertical id from the onboarded workspace, then `argo memory append`s it as a worker_action memory row so the rest of the V3 ledger surface (`argo worker actions list/show/approve/execute/complete`) has something to work with. The shape mirrors what argo_cli::handlers::worker_actions_emit writes at runtime.
